items.title: Elastic 9.6: AlertZero, ES|QL S3 Data Federation, Universal Alerting, and more!
items.summary: We are pleased to announce the availability of Elastic 9.6 capabilities in serverless. Elastic 9.6 is expected to be available for ECH and Self-Managed deployments in early December. This release includes major advancements across Elastic’s platform.
items.creator: Sarah Leslie
